name: Barak
summary: The son of Abinoam, whom Deborah called to lead Israel against Sisera. With ten thousand men he came down from Mount Tabor and destroyed Sisera's army.

key_moments.title: Will Not Go Without Deborah
key_moments.description: Deborah called Barak from Kedesh-naphtali and gave him the LORD's command to gather men at Mount Tabor. Barak said he would go only if she went with him.

key_moments.title: Routs Sisera's Army
key_moments.description: At Deborah's word, Barak led ten thousand men down from Mount Tabor. The LORD routed Sisera's army, and Barak chased it to Harosheth until not one man was left.

key_moments.title: Finds Sisera Dead in Jael's Tent
key_moments.description: Chasing Sisera, Barak met Jael, who brought him into her tent. There Sisera lay dead.

key_moments.title: Singing with Deborah
key_moments.description: Barak and Deborah sang together, praising the LORD for avenging Israel.
